name.en-US: The Foot of the Cross, or the Sorrows of Mary
name.pt-BR: Ao Pé da Cruz, ou as Dores de Maria

description.en-US: Faber's treatise of 1858 on the sorrows of Our Lady: nine chapters on the martyrdom of Mary, the foot of the cross, her compassion and the devotion of the Seven Dolours, in which each chapter is divided into sections.
description.pt-BR: O tratado de Faber (1858) sobre as dores de Nossa Senhora: nove capítulos sobre o martírio de Maria, o pé da cruz, a sua compaixão e a devoção às Sete Dores, cada capítulo dividido em seções.

en-US.editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1858)

sources.edition: The Foot of the Cross, or the Sorrows of Mary (London: Richardson and Son, 1858), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The preface is kept; the analytic table of contents and the advertisements are dropped. Faber's sections are headings within each chapter. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Fr. Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1858, so the text is public domain.
